title: The break-room QR says “benefits update”
scenario: A professionally printed QR sticker near the break room says employees must scan to confirm next year’s benefits. The page uses company colors and asks for SSO plus an MFA approval.

answers.A: Use it because the QR is physically inside the office and benefits season is approaching.
answers.B: Do not use the QR; check the HR portal/intranet or ask HR whether the campaign is real.
answers.C: Report the sticker to security and photograph it for investigation without entering credentials.

explanation: Attackers can place physical QR codes in trusted spaces. Physical proximity does not authenticate a digital destination.
proTip: Inside the office is not the same as inside the company network.
